WITH event_spending_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    b.link_to_event,
    e.type,
    AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) as event_avg_rate
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE b.spent != 0 AND b.amount != 0
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type
),
type_avg_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    type,
    AVG(event_avg_rate) as type_avg_rate
  FROM event_spending_rates
  GROUP BY type
),
overall_mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_rate) as overall_mean
  FROM type_avg_rates
)
SELECT 
  ta.type,
  ta.type_avg_rate,
  ta.type_avg_rate / om.overall_mean as normalized_rate
FROM type_avg_rates ta
CROSS JOIN overall_mean_rate om
ORDER BY ta.type

alternatives.interpretation: Each event's spending rate is the total-spent-divided-by-total-amount (weighted rate) rather than the arithmetic mean of individual line rates
alternatives.sql:
WITH event_spending_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    b.link_to_event,
    e.type,
    SUM(b.spent * 1.0) / SUM(b.amount) as event_avg_rate
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE b.spent != 0 AND b.amount != 0
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type
),
type_avg_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    type,
    AVG(event_avg_rate) as type_avg_rate
  FROM event_spending_rates
  GROUP BY type
),
overall_mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_avg_rate) as overall_mean
  FROM type_avg_rates
)
SELECT 
  ta.type,
  ta.type_avg_rate,
  ta.type_avg_rate / om.overall_mean as normalized_rate
FROM type_avg_rates ta
CROSS JOIN overall_mean_rate om
ORDER BY ta.type
